Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

Record Class RedisServerInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.redis.RedisServerInfo
public record RedisServerInfo(String product, String version, String mode) extends Record
What the server says it is, parsed from the INFO server reply: which product (Redis, Valkey, KeyDB, Dragonfly…), which version, and which mode (standalone, cluster or sentinel).

The Redis command set is not one fixed language. GETDEL and HRANDFIELD arrive in 6.2, FUNCTION and EXPIRETIME in 7.0, hash-field TTLs in 7.4; forks answer to different names and version numbers; managed services block administrative commands entirely. This class turns the server's own answer into a version we can compare against, so the client can say "your server is 6.0, that command needs 7.0" instead of failing with a bare error.

Pure: parse(java.lang.String) takes the INFO text, so every rule here is testable without a server.
